title.zh: 刑法典修正第 2 号命令 2018(1)

source.name: Attorney General's Chambers, Brunei Darussalam (AGC) — LAWS OF BRUNEI / Government Gazette

completenessNote: 来源为 AGC 官方 PDF《S-71-2018-E-PENAL-CODE-AMENDMENT-NO.-2-ORDER-2018(1).pdf》（2 页），本次切分 2 条。该 PDF 为扫描件 + OCR 文本层，正文按版式位置重建：已剔除页眉页脚与边栏条标题、回接折行；未改写措辞、未增删内容。OCR 层面可能存在个别粘连或形近字，逐字引用请以原始 PDF 为准。

text.en: This Order may be cited as the Penal Code (Amendment) (No. 2) Order, Amendment of section 55 of Chapter 22

Section 55 of the Penal Code is amended by deleting "the Minister may without the consent of the person sentenced" from the second and third lines and by substituting "His Majesty the Sultan and Yang Di-Pertuan may" therefor. Made this 9th. day of Rabiulakhir, 1440 Hijriah corresponding to the 17th. day of December, 2018 at Our Istana Nurul Iman, Bandar Seri Begawan, Brunei Darussalam.

THE SULTAN AND YANG DI-PERTUAN

BRUNEI DARUSSALAM
